name: flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
description: A grid of small squares that blink between dim and bright on a canvas. Stills under reduced motion and rests off screen.

props.name: squareSize
props.description: Side of each square in pixels.

props.name: flickerChance
props.description: Chance per second that a square picks a new brightness.

props.name: maxOpacity
props.description: Brightest a square can get, from 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS color. Defaults to the foreground token.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
